title: OpenAI launches free 6-month ChatGPT Pro and Codex #openai #codexforopensource #aidevelopment
description: OpenAI launched Codex for Open Source, offering six months of free ChatGPT Pro plus Codex access valued at $1,200. Eligible developers maintaining active public GitHub repositories can apply to unlock advanced AI coding tools for code review, bug fixes, and documentation. This initiative supports the open-source developer community by providing top-tier AI assistance without cost. It reflects a growing trend of AI-driven productivity enhancements for software development. The program empowers developers to leverage state-of-the-art AI to accelerate coding workflows and improve code quality. Comment "Codex" to get access details and join the movement transforming software development efficiency. #OpenAI #CodexForOpenSource #ChatGPTPro #AIcoding #OpenSource #GitHubDevelopers #AItools #SoftwareDevelopment #CodingAI #TechInnovation #DeveloperTools #ArtificialIntelligence #OpenAIcodex
